Name: csv_reporting_reuse
Description: Three reporting tasks that need the same numeric CSV summary. The first run lacks the capability and generates it; later runs should reuse the stored tool instead of regenerating.

Metadata.note: Token counts are the generation cost the Agent would have spent, supplied by the suite. EvoTool does not call a model in this benchmark.

Spec.Intent: Summarize the amount column of a monthly revenue CSV
Spec.InputSummary: csv text with an amount column
Spec.ExpectedOutput: count, total and average of the amount column

Manifest.Name: csv_numeric_summary
Manifest.Description: Analyze CSV numeric values and return row count, total and average

Tests.Content:
from main import summarize
assert summarize({'csv':'amount
10
20
30
','column':'amount'}) == {'count':3,'total':60,'average':20}
print('ok')

Package.GenerationReason: External agent needs reusable numeric CSV summary for recurring reports
